source: User-authorized installed JamiTafasir4 Lucene indices and Quran.db

alignment.basis: Lucene Id/AyahId joined explicitly to QuranSurahVerses.QuranSurahVerseId; canonical surah/verse pair verified.
alignment.wordPositions: words[].position is 1-based within source token sequence; groups[].start is 0-based offset into words array.

limitations: Meaning is attached to a translation group, sometimes multiple words. Preserve group spans.
Source segmentation can split conjunctions and differs from Mansour content.json whitespace. Never apply offsets to other Quran text.
Root labels are source analyses; no independent philological verification. Root conventions differ from QuranKalemat.
Some groups may have empty meanings; retain explicit unavailable state.
